meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对代谢网络进行约束性建模与通量分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要分析代谢网络、预测基因敲除或进行通量平衡分析。
copy.tagline_en: Perform constraint-based modeling and flux analysis of metabolic networks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze metabolic networks, predict gene knockouts, or perform flux balance analysis.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 能直接计算和分析代谢模型:读入或导出 SBML 等模型文件,运行代谢通量分析(FBA/FVA)、基因敲除、通量采样等模拟,并给出数值结果。
howto.when: 当用户提出代谢建模或计算模拟任务时触发,例如要求做通量分析(FBA/FVA)、基因敲除、最小培养基设计等。

say.text: 帮我加载 e_coli_core 模型,做一次 FBA,告诉我生长速率。
say.note: 运行后返回生长速率和各反应通量。

say.text: 对 e_coli_core 模型做单基因敲除筛选,列出必需基因。
say.note: 结果会标出生长低于阈值 0.01 的基因。

say.text: 计算支持 50% 最大生长的最小培养基成分。
say.note: 结果给出培养基成分及对应通量。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can compute and analyze metabolic models with COBRApy: load or export SBML and other model files, run FBA, FVA, gene knockout screens, flux sampling, and report numeric results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for metabolic modeling or simulation tasks, such as flux analysis (FBA/FVA), gene knockouts, or minimal media design.

say_en.text: Load the e_coli_core model, run FBA, and report the growth rate.
say_en.note: Returns the growth rate and reaction fluxes after solving.

say_en.text: Run single-gene deletion screening on e_coli_core and list essential genes.
say_en.note: Flags genes whose growth falls below 0.01.

say_en.text: Compute the minimal medium that supports 50% of maximum growth.
say_en.note: Returns the medium components and their fluxes.
